mapper.select: SELECT PMST, PMKY, PMCO, PMNM, PMV1, PMV2, PMV3,PMV4,PMV5, TO_CHAR(INSERTTIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS insertTime, TO_CHAR(UPDATETIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime FROM CMF_WEIXIN_PARAMETER WHERE PMST = 'CONFIG' AND PMKY = 'PUBLIC' AND PMCO='accessToken'
